snippet.title: Project: Break//Down Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Project: Break//Down is a single-player, experimental physics-based, FPB (First Person Brawler) set in the future in a warehouse with rogue robots. utilize a unique player controller allowing each hand to grab items in your environment to use as weapons and a unique sub-ragdoll and dismemberment system for enemies, which allows for a feeling of deep impact. Punch a robot’s head off and use said head to hit another.

Steam Page (try the demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317220/Project_BreakDown/

Website: https://www.fistfacestudios.com/
